walkthroughs.body_html:
The brain weighs about 1.4 kg and has billions of cells called neurons.

It runs everything — movement, thinking, breathing, feelings. 🧠

Each side of the brain has lobes:

  • Frontal lobe — planning, decisions, personality.
  • Parietal — touch and space.
  • Temporal — hearing and memory.
  • Occipital — vision.

Under the lobes:

  • Cerebellum — balance, riding a bike.
  • Amygdala — fear, anger.
  • Hippocampus — long-term memory.

Together they keep you alive and you. ❤️
